response.sql: WITH site_artifacts AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) as artifact_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), total_artifacts AS (SELECT SUM(artifact_count) as overall_total FROM site_artifacts), shares AS (SELECT sa.zoneref, sa.artifact_count, CAST(sa.artifact_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(ta.overall_total AS NUMERIC) as share FROM site_artifacts sa CROSS JOIN total_artifacts ta WHERE ta.overall_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), differences AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.artifact_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share as difference FROM shares s CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL) SELECT zoneref, artifact_count as articount, share, difference FROM differences ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
